data.name: Demonic Obedience
data.description: Perch atop a high outcrop and look out over the surrounding terrain. If the outcrop is in an uninhabited area, you need to do nothing more but wait for an hour, but if the outcrop is in an inhabited area (such as a city), no passersby should realise you are a living thing - any who do must be slain before the hour's end. Gain a +4 profane bonus on saving throws against effects that cause sickness, nausea, fatigue, or exhaustion.
